responsibility: This file implements GCC’s generic RTL dumping and pretty-printing machinery. It defines rtx_writer formatting of arbitrary RTX trees, slim and full insn/value dumps, reuse-ID support for shared RTX nodes, human-readable printing of notes, patterns, MEM annotations, and graph labels, and the debugger-facing debug_* entry points built on those facilities. Its responsibility is low-level textual rendering of RTL objects and insns across both generator and compiler builds, rather than whole-function structure dumping or parsing.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/print-rtl.h, which declares the RTL dumping API and helper classes, this file provides their concrete formatting logic, including rtx_writer behavior, slim/full RTL and insn dumps, reuse-ID handling for shared RTX nodes, and debugger-facing print routines.
